candidates.statement: Payment authorizations are slow: payment p95 for /v1/authorizations is ~4875ms while gateway/order checkout p95 is ~2406ms. Traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations ending in transport ReadTimeout, propagating 502 to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout. Payment still returns 200s, so it is slow rather than down.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or dependency metrics admitted; exact slow span inside payment unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s (~2s durations) align with order->payment ReadTimeout in traces. Payment p95 latency (~4875ms) exceeds the observed timeout window while payment still serves 200s, and order/gateway p95 (~2406ms) matches the failing request durations. Inventory/redis calls succeed. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency causing checkout timeouts.
